aiDevWorkflow.contentRoot.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a folder holding your team's `config/` and `prompts/`. Optional convenience: setting it fills in the four paths below, and leaves alone any you have changed yourself. Copy `examples/content-template` for the expected layout.

aiDevWorkflow.microserviceConfig.markdownDescription: **Required.** Absolute path to a JSON file describing your microservices and their git locations. There is no default — the extension ships no service catalogue, because one belonging to another team would be cloned onto your disk.

aiDevWorkflow.platformConfig.markdownDescription: **Required.** Absolute path to a JSON file listing your platforms.

aiDevWorkflow.customPrompts.markdownDescription: Optional. Absolute path to a folder of markdown files used to prompt Copilot, laid out as `<workflowId>/<stepId>.md`. Any template you do not supply uses the one shipped with the extension, so overriding a single prompt needs a single file. A name differing only in case — `aiHandoff.MD` for `aiHandoff.md` — is reported rather than silently ignored.

aiDevWorkflow.toolsConfig.markdownDescription: Optional. Absolute path to a JSON file listing the tools the System Check step looks for on a developer's machine. If you supply none, a default list is used — git, a JDK, Maven and Gradle — and the step's report says which list it used. Copy `examples/content-template/config/tools.json` for the expected shape.

aiDevWorkflow.tasksRoot.description: Where task folders are created. Defaults to ~/ai-dev-workflow/tasks.

aiDevWorkflow.codeRoot.description: Where repositories are cloned. Defaults to ~/ai-dev-workflow/code.

aiDevWorkflow.updateManifestUrl.description: URL of a JSON manifest stating the latest published version. Empty disables the check.

aiDevWorkflow.taskId.description: Set automatically in generated workspace files. Do not edit.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
